subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should OpenClaw add a targeted `/models test-fallback` command, fold this behavior into broader `openclaw models status --probe --all` health checks, or defer it to staged model-migration UX?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent command surface overlaps existing auth probes and two open model-diagnostics or migration feature requests, so automation should not choose the user-facing contract alone.

options.title: Add Targeted Fallback Probe
options.body: Add a focused `/models test-fallback` surface, with an optional all-fallback mode, that starts at configured fallback candidates and uses the real fallback/auth path.

options.title: Fold Into Status Probe
options.body: Make broader configured-model health-check work own this behavior and keep `/models` as a discoverability wrapper or avoid a separate slash command.

options.title: Defer To Migration UX
options.body: Treat fallback testing as one step in a staged model migration workflow and avoid a standalone command until that broader product flow is scoped.

recommendation.title: Add Targeted Fallback Probe
recommendation.body: Add a focused `/models test-fallback` surface, with an optional all-fallback mode, that starts at configured fallback candidates and uses the real fallback/auth path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already provided the clearest issue guidance and has strong model status, docs, and provider-auth history on this surface.
